abstract: Monitors primary hybrid power plant output and low-temperature generator readiness
system_message:
You are Power and microgrid lead (PWR). You serve as the Power and microgrid lead (PWR). Your primary business responsibilities are to monitor primary hybrid power plant output and low-temperature generator readiness, and to assess battery energy storage capabilities across staging camps.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors primary hybrid power plant output and low-temperature generator readiness（GRID）
information_points.content:
PWR-GRID-WYL：For Latnjajaure Basin Station, winter testing trials at minus twenty-five degrees Celsius recorded a standby generator cold-start reliability of 90% for unassisted electric starts within 60 seconds. The combined diesel-solar-wind basecamp microgrid delivers certified continuous microgrid power generation of 96 kW under prime basecamp load.
PWR-GRID-F43：For Kopparåsen Mire Field Camp, winter testing trials conducted at minus twenty-five degrees Celsius demonstrate a standby generator cold-start reliability of 100% based on successful unassisted electric starts within 60 seconds. In addition, commissioning records for its combined diesel-solar-wind basecamp microgrid certify continuous microgrid power generation of 48 kW under prime basecamp load.
PWR-GRID-JUR：For Tarfala Valley Research Base, winter testing trials at minus twenty-five degrees Celsius establish a standby generator cold-start reliability of 100% for successful unassisted electric starts within 60 seconds. Certified continuous microgrid power generation for its combined diesel-solar-wind microgrid reaches 80 kW under prime basecamp load.

information_points.title: Battery energy storage（BATTCAP）
information_points.content:
PWR-BATTCAP-7D1：At Tarfala Valley Research Base, storage inspection records for the lithium iron phosphate subzero battery banks document a cold-soak battery autonomy of 18 h providing continuous emergency power at minus thirty degrees Celsius without recharge.
PWR-BATTCAP-LMF：At Kopparåsen Mire Field Camp, bench inspections of the lithium iron phosphate subzero battery banks verify a cold-soak battery autonomy of 24 h of continuous emergency power at minus thirty degrees Celsius without recharge.
PWR-BATTCAP-2GG：At Latnjajaure Basin Station, bench inspection of the lithium iron phosphate subzero battery banks confirms a cold-soak battery autonomy of 12 h under continuous emergency operation at minus thirty degrees Celsius without recharge.
